notes.title: The Future of the Game! Last update of the Year!
notes.content:
New build is out. Here are the changes:

UI Updates
Updated the UI. Much more accessible now. Pretty good looking if I do say so myself!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252034/314248d9543f7e168373fb341c158dc12a554f01.png

Speedrun Mode
I had this in the build from last year but you can now skip some cutscenes and hop right into the action. Recommended for people who have played before and want to go through quickly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252034/9db8c0cd9b7c60b3b4bf36f871cd10462b088e36.png

The Future of the Game
I've been working on the game fulltime since July... that has to change. I can no longer support myself and will have to find some sort of job to help fund the game. I have been trying to pitch to publishers but none that have gotten back to me are interested currently. My plan right now is to consider crowdfunding next year or just to make this a side hustle essentially instead of my main focus until it can become as such. It sucks but I gotta make money somehow. If you played the game and had fun with it, Thanks! I want to make a game that's fun. Happy Holidays!

-Micah

notes.title: HERE WE GO!! PLAY THE PROLOGUE OF MOSAIC HEARTS!!
notes.content:
THIS IS IT!! THE GAME THAT I'VE BEEN WANTING TO SHOW YOU!!

CHAPTER 00 - 01 IS NOW OUT!! A lot has changed but some has stayed the same. I spent the past year getting the mechanics and everything as clean as I could before showing you guys again!

The game is the actual prologue and Chapter 01 of the game. The enemy is still Tabatha but now we've got: 

 A proper tutorial.
 The story is actually filled out.
 You can ACTUALLY CHANGE YOUR COMBO vs the lie I told to you below (oops...).
 MUCH FASTER GAMEPLAY!!
 New superboss!!
 SO MUCH!!! JUST SOOOO MUCH!!!


It's good and gives you a preview of what the full game could be! I'm so proud of this game. Give it a playthrough! I'm sure you'll love it too.

-Micah

notes.title: Final Update for the Prototype! Version 1.51!
notes.content:
Hey there! Micah here! 

As the title says, this is the final update for the prototype. I feel I've done all I can to make this the best thing it could be. I hope you enjoy playing it!

So what's changed?

CHANGES
 + Flier & Flyer Girls can now be your friends. If you beat the 100 Man(it's called "Enemy" but I call it "Man" because of Way of the Samurai) challenge.
+ I tried optimizing the house. Reflections are either on Realtime or reflecting the room not in realtime. You can toggle in the Options Menu.
+ Hopefully the cutscene camera bug has been fixed.
+ Fixed Team Attack bug. Jonn hitting people now damages them again. Before he couldn't hurt anyone.
+ During the 100 Man challenge, enemies could combo you with OTGs (attacks that deal damage when you're On The Ground) and there would be nothing you could do but take damage. Now if you're on the ground, you can't be hit.
+ The Support extra damage actually works now. It's awesome!

What's next?
Now that I have a prototype done, I'm going to go and pitch to a publishers. The hope is that someone will pick it up and will go like, "Hey, give me dat! I want dat! Here's money for dat!"

If that happens Mosaic Hearts will become a full game by mid to late 2023. That's the hope but the pitching process could take a long time... We'll have to see. 

Anyway, thanks for playing! If you enjoyed the game, please ask people to wishlist it. Or don't. 

I can't load my save!
If you wanna try the post game stuff and your save doesn't work, contact me at dailypastastudios@gmail.com. I can give you instructions on how to fix it.

Or you could just do speedrun new game and get through it fast. Apparently, it only takes about 10-12 minutes to speedrun the whole thing. You can watch me and my friend, who has tested the game almost as much as me, have a speedrun race in the link!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lrQjdElyvuU

See ya,
-Micah

notes.title: Mosaic Hearts Version 1.5
notes.content:
Version 1.5
A major update. 1.5! Lots of postgame content. Here's a rundown.

Optimized
The game used to be about 5GB of Storage and I got it to a little over 2GB! Most of the sprites are better optimized for the game and now the edge lighting works a lot better! 

New Content
3 new Post-Game Minigames.
New Enemies the Flier Girls.


Flier Girls
So these are the Flier Girls. In the final game, they're the tutorial level enemies. 
There are two types of them. The Flier Girls who throw the fliers and  the Flyer Girls who use their flier to fly. 

:D Do you love it as much as I do?

Plenty of stuff to try. If you haven't picked up the game yet. Now's the best time! Tell your friends to give it a try!

Have fun,
-Micah
